mentions.name: Knife Steel Comparison Database
mentions.description: This web tool is a knife steel comparison database that lets users visually compare knife steels across key performance axes — edge retention, corrosion resistance, toughness, and ease of sharpening — using interactive radar charts. It supports filtering by use case (EDC favorites, budget-friendly, high edge retention, etc.) to quickly show tradeoffs between steels like S35VN, MagnaCut, and M390.
mentions.problem: Knife forum discussions keep recurring with "which steel is best" debates and no good way to actually compare steel data side by side.
mentions.audience: Knife hobbyists and enthusiasts who debate steel choices in knife forums
